jobs.title: Senior SDET (FICTIONAL)
jobs.description: FICTIONAL posting. Maple Ledger is hiring a Senior SDET to own test automation for our payments platform. What you'll do: design and maintain API test suites in Java with REST Assured and JUnit 5; build UI regression tests with Playwright; run suites in Jenkins pipelines and keep them stable; review pull requests for testability; mentor two junior QA engineers. Requirements: 5+ years in test automation, strong Java, REST API testing, SQL for data checks, experience with CI/CD (Jenkins or GitHub Actions). Nice to have: Kafka, k6 performance testing, AWS.

jobs.title: QA Lead (FICTIONAL)
jobs.description: FICTIONAL posting. We need a QA Lead for our clinical scheduling product. Responsibilities: define the test strategy and test plans for each release; lead a team of four testers; coordinate UAT with clinic staff; run defect triage with developers and product managers; report release readiness to stakeholders. Requirements: 7+ years in QA with 2+ years leading testers, experience with Jira and test case management, API testing with Postman, Selenium automation, strong communication.
